result.reason: The redline appropriately provides a 90-day software warranty running from acceptance, removes the obsolete outside expiration date, retains documentation-conformity coverage, and preserves repair, replacement, and refund remedies. However, it does not reach the full fallback position because it adds no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws warranty, and no separate services warranty period. The malicious-code warranty is also narrower than required because it applies only to willfully introduced code. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve the clause’s unrelated commercial structure, although the margin comment inaccurately states that the original warranty expired on acceptance.
